Paper Name: Design & simulation of hydrogen based hybrid green power system using sea water for Cox's Bazar
NOTES: System uses Gas Turbine Generator (3 MW) not fuel cell or diesel generator. No inverter needed per authors. PV derating factor: 80%. Total system initial cost: $6,115,000. Total system annual cost: $388,195/yr. Total system replacement cost: $2,501,160. Gas turbine: 3,000 kW, lifetime 25,000 h / 14 yr operational, fuel curve intercept 0.01400 L/hr/kW, slope 0.0420 L/hr/kW. Wind turbine: XL-500, rotor diameter 22 m, hub height 35 m, start-up speed 2.5 m/s, cut-out speed 25 m/s, total capacity 4.5 MW (9 x 500 kW). Total H2 production: 1,400,659.79 kg/yr (Table 11) vs 140,060 kg/yr (Table 14) — discrepancy in paper. PV levelized cost: 0.039 $/kWh. Wind levelized cost: 0.040 $/kWh. COE labelled as 'Overall cost of energy' in Table 15. Electrolyzer specific fuel consumption: 46.41 kWh/kg. Peak load: 9 MW. Demand schedule: 5-10 PM. Annual avg solar radiation: 4.77 kWh/m2/day. Annual avg wind speed: 3.55 m/s. PEM electrolyzer with sea water. No battery storage. Using HOMER Pro software. Total electricity production: 9,969,159 kWh/yr (PV 33%, Wind 34%, GT 33%). Gas turbine H2 consumption: 137,803 L/yr or kg/yr (unit discrepancy in paper — Table 12 says L/yr, Table 14 says kg/yr). Project location: Diabatic beach, Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh (21°26.4'N, 91°57.7'E). Annual avg clearness index: 0.526. Gas turbine operational life: 14 yr. Wind turbine rated capacity reported as 500 kW x 9 = 4.5 MW — individual rating 500 kW used for rated_power column. NPV/PV panel count not reported — only total capacity 2,200 kW. No discount rate (r) reported. Total annual load has slight discrepancy: 3,285,000 kWh/yr (Table 7) vs 3,281.03 MWh/yr (conclusion). Using Table 7 value.
